analysis:
This batch contains documentation changes only. changelog.d/overlapped-weight-verification.md (head 1-9) is a new changelog. docs/reference/configuration.md (head 602-606) describes overlapped weight hashing: a reader thread stays one 4 MiB chunk ahead of SHA-256, using two page-aligned buffers per file (OverlappedFileDigest, WeightHasher.uncachedChunkBytes). Both files state that digests are unchanged and that F_NOCACHE/PageCache.drop behavior is retained. No Swift source for WeightHasher or OverlappedFileDigest is in this batch, so the implementation was not examined.

Security relevance: weight-hash integrity feeds T-012/T-027 (weight substitution), verified-weights records (DARKBLOOM_VERIFIED_WEIGHTS_FILE), and the SSD prefix-cache weightHash binding in T-041 (pre/post-load fresh hashes).

Questions for an integration or source pass:
(1) The overlapped reader must hash bytes strictly in file order, with no buffer reuse races. Swapping or reusing a buffer while the hasher still reads it could produce a wrong digest. That would be a correctness or fail-open risk.
(2) Short reads and EOF must be handled correctly.
(3) Read errors must propagate as hash failure, not as a truncated digest.
(4) The reader thread must stop on cancellation. Memory use is two buffers per file times concurrent hashes, a small availability concern (T-016/T-029).
(5) The fallback readers must still be used on failure.

The documentation makes no change to trust boundaries, keys, attestation, or cache scoping, so there is no documentation-level regression.
